大型工程模型的使用条件是什么？: What do you need to view large engineering models?
模型规模、单个对象的复杂度、设备内存和可用存储共同决定体验。精细构件按预算加载，: Model size, individual object complexity, device memory and available storage all affect your experience. Detailed components load within a resource budget, while distant views retain a lightweight overview. For large models in the Web Viewer, preparing a BCV cache package is recommended. During the closed beta, you can assess performance with your actual devices and models.
测量结果如何用于工程核对？: How should you use measurements for engineering checks?
请先确认模型单位与捕捉基准。面积按显示三角网格计算，点到面显示所选三角面所在平面: Confirm model units and snapping references first. Areas are calculated from the display triangle mesh. Point-to-surface measurements show the perpendicular distance to the plane containing the selected triangle. Displayed surfaces may approximate the precise design geometry, so check critical dimensions against the original design documentation.
